title: James Clerk Maxwell: A Treatise on Electricity and Magnetism, Volume I Source-Checked LaTeX Working Tranches
version: 2026-06-12 source-checked working tranches through book page 267
description:
Dedicated James Clerk Maxwell working-edition record for A Treatise on Electricity and Magnetism, Volume I. This package gathers source-checked LaTeX working tranches from the old-physics lane, with the page ledger as the authority for coverage.

Status at a glance. The ledger-backed source-checked material covers book pages 95-101, 103, 105, 109, and the main continuous run 111-267. It is not a complete Treatise edition and not a final critical edition. The broader batch TeX/PDF files are included as a working substrate but are status-mixed; the ledger and delta packets govern source-checked claims.

The package includes the source-check ledger, compact source-checked delta packets with page/range source witnesses and render checks, the current batch TeX/PDF substrate, Internet Archive master-image indexes and OCR/XML witnesses, audit notes, and SHA256 checksums. OCR is used as a locator/witness layer, not as textual authority.
notes: Curated package created from the local Maxwell old-physics lane. Publish and read as source-checked working tranches, not as a complete Maxwell Treatise. Current verified range from the ledger: 95-101, 103, 105, 109, 111-267.
